newsitem.title: USA: Turner sees increased construction costs.
newsitem.headline: Turner sees increased construction costs.

text.p: The Turner Corp said Monday that construction costs will see continued increases in the second quarter of 1997.

According to the Turner Building Cost Index, the second quarter index will increase 1.2 percent to 521, six points above the previous quarter, and 3.6 percent higher than the first quarter of 1996, the company said.

"The strengthening of the construction market nationally continues to put upwards pressure on costs from a capacity utilization standpoint," said Karl Almstead, the Turner vice president responsible for calculating the Turner Building Cost Index.
"The rate of increase forecasted for the second quarter is the first time the index has increased more than 1 percent since the first quarter of 1995," Almstead said.
